alt.en: Timber pergola with a grid of beams and lattice panels at the corners, seen from above on a terrace

caption.tr: Taş döşeli terasa kurulan pergola yukarıdan görülüyor. Köşelerdeki ahşap kafes paneller dikmeleri çevreliyor.
caption.en: A pergola on a paved terrace, seen from above. Timber lattice panels wrap the posts at the corners.
